# Monoprice Support

> Comprehensive support documentation for Monoprice customers covering account management, ordering, payments, shipping, returns, and B2B business solutions.

Monoprice Support is a Kayako-powered help center providing detailed guides for individual and business customers. The site covers the complete customer journey from account setup through returns, with specialized sections for business accounts, international shipping to 15+ countries, and multiple payment methods including Affirm, PayPal, and corporate net terms.

## Key Topics

- Account Management
- Order Placement & Confirmation
- Payment Methods (Visa, PayPal, Affirm, Venmo)
- Shipping & Tracking
- International Shipping
- Returns & RMA Process
- Refunds & Store Credit
- Return Policy
- Warranty Coverage
- Business Accounts
- Purchase Orders
- Pricing & Promotions
- Sales Tax & Tax-Exempt
- Customer Support Tickets

## Getting Started & Support

- [Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com): Monoprice support hub covering account, ordering, returns, shipping, and FAQ
- [Start a new conversation - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/conversation/new): Contact form for submitting new support tickets to Monoprice

## Account & Authentication

- [My Account - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/53-my-account): Account management guide covering login, password reset, and security

## Ordering & Payments

- [Ordering - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/54-ordering): Ordering documentation including placement, confirmation, and fraud prevention
- [Payment - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/55-payment): Payment methods guide covering Affirm, PayPal, Venmo, Visa, and tax
- [Pricing & Promotions - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/56-pricing-promotions): Pricing, promotions, promo codes, and price protection information

## Shipping & Fulfillment

- [Shipping - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/9-shipping): Shipping documentation with methods, costs, tracking, and international options
- [What countries does Monoprice currently ship to? - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/article/27-what-countries-does-monoprice-currently-ship-to): International shipping destinations including UK, Australia, Bermuda, Brazil
- [Store & Will Call - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/57-store-will-call): Los Angeles store and will-call pickup information and operations

## Returns, Refunds & Warranty

- [Returns - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/8-returns): Returns and refund process guide including warranty and damaged items
- [Return Policy - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/article/230-return-policy): Monoprice return policy with RMA process, timeframe, and conditions
- [How do I request a return? - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/article/229-how-do-i-request-a-return): Step-by-step guide for requesting returns and RMA authorization
- [How will I be refunded for purchases made with a gift/prepaid debit card? - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/article/231-how-will-i-be-refunded-for-purchases-made-with-a-gift-prepaid-debit-card): Refund guide for gift/prepaid debit card purchases and store credit
- [Monoprice Warranty - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/article/263-monoprice-warranty): Monoprice warranty policy and coverage information by product

## Business Accounts & B2B

- [Business Account - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/64-business-account): Business account setup and B2B services including purchase orders
- [Orders - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/69-orders): Business ordering guide covering bulk orders, quick order, and net terms
- [Payments - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/68-payments): Business payment methods including line of credit and purchase orders
- [Quotes - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/67-quotes): Business quotes feature for pricing and quote history management
- [Subaccounts - Monoprice Support](https://monopricesupport.kayako.com/section/66-subaccounts): Business subaccount management, permissions, and credit line sharing
